# MUIRO

> MUIRO is a fashion editorial site featuring outfit lookbooks and curated product links.

## Public site

- [MUIRO](https://muirofashion.netlify.app/): browse fashion lookbooks, outfit ideas, and the products featured in each edit.

## Editorial notes

- Lookbooks connect visual outfit inspiration with product references.
- Product links may lead to participating retailers; MUIRO does not control retailer pricing, stock, or availability.
- Confirm current product details on the retailer's own page.
- The public site is a client-rendered storefront. The homepage is the only sitemap URL until distinct, content-rich static item pages are introduced.

## Scope

This file is a plain-text site guide, not a product feed, inventory source, or guarantee of inclusion in any search or AI answer.
